conventions.evidence: Reuses Password facade (PasswordResetLinkController.php:166, NewPasswordController.php:110), EmailVerificationRequest (VerifyEmailController.php:60), inline $request->validate per controller pattern, MustVerifyEmail on User.php:190, docs synced via docs/ops/account-mail.md:1 and CHANGELOG.md:12; no service layers, no Livewire, Bulma classes with {{ }} escaping in views

readability.evidence: Small focused controllers (VerifyEmailController.php:60, NewPasswordController.php:92, PasswordResetLinkController.php:152), clear route names in routes/web.php:728-738, PHPDoc on actions, consistent Blade with accessible labels resources/views/auth/forgot-password.blade.php:316

requirements.evidence: Locale/name pinned .env.example:6-14 and phpunit.xml:275-277; theme pegafila config/mail.php:213 and pegafila.css:651-658 (.button-primary #0f7490); subjects lang/pt_BR.json:255,263; reset flow routes/web.php:727-734 + controllers PasswordResetLinkController.php:162-168/NewPasswordController.php:102-128 always returns passwords.sent; verify route routes/web.php:736-738 + VerifyEmailController.php:60-64 fulfills and redirects to /

scope.evidence: Diff only adds password-reset/verification controllers, routes/web.php:727-738, two auth views, pegafila.css theme, two pt-BR subject lines, three phpunit pins, three feature test files plus CHANGELOG.md:26 and docs/ops/account-mail.md:1; no login/registration, layouts, ui.php, Docker or SCSS changes

security.evidence: Verification uses auth+signed+throttle:6,1 routes/web.php:736-738 and EmailVerificationRequest 403 check VerifyEmailController.php:57-60; password.email validates email and throttles routes/web.php:729-731, never enumerates PasswordResetLinkController.php:166-168; password.update validates token/email/strong password NewPasswordController.php:104-108, rotates remember_token:115, Blade uses {{ }} only

simplicity.evidence: Minimum reuse of framework: Password::sendResetLink/reset, EmailVerificationRequest::fulfill, MustVerifyEmail, default mail theme derived copy; no custom notifications, actions, or components; controllers 23/58/34 lines

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/AccountMailTest.php:754-794 locale/theme/pt-BR subjects and inlining; EmailVerificationTest.php:829-864 valid link verifies plus wrong-hash/other-id/unsigned 403; PasswordResetTest.php:892-1002 existing/unknown same status, validation, throttle 429, guest redirect, token rotation, PasswordReset event, weak-password datasets

review.summary: Delivers the full pt-BR password-reset flow and signed email-verification link with the pegafila mail theme using only framework notifications. Requirements, contract, conventions, security, tests, simplicity, readability and scope are all met with no blocking issues.
